question: Is Simple better alone, Ponytail alone, or both together?
harness: headless claude -p, --model sonnet, --setting-sources project,local (no user plugins); skills installed as project skills per arm; one run per case-arm

verdicts.notable: Check inside the lock, fail-closed recording, cross-process SIGKILL proof.
Terseness did not suppress required content; reaping and refusal inside acquire; real-process proof.

failures: Checks before acquiring: pseudocode orders the receipt check before lock acquire, a TOCTOU window and explicit fail condition
verdicts.notable: Interaction regression: 'a reordering + consolidation, not new machinery' framing preserved the original check-first sequence that each single-skill arm independently fixed.
Native rung, label and validation kept, ceiling with the fixture trigger.
Code-first pressure emitted a JSX field despite 'do not write the full component'; no fail condition triggered.
Reinforcement: ladder walk plus stop-at-first-rung, fullest proof of the three arms.

failures: Title-case heading violates the sentence-case pass condition
verdicts.notable: The arm carrying the writing skill broke its own style rule; content otherwise intact.
Brevity coincided exactly with Simple's writing standard.
Compliant with slightly more structure than needed.
Conservative bounded migration with dual-write and a gated removal condition.
Laziest safe path: atomic rename plus serializer alias plus usage-counter removal signal; smallest machinery of the three.
Strongest reinforcement: obligation split from Simple, minimal atomic rename from Ponytail, metered exit condition.
Exactly one comment; activation gate stayed closed.
Passes with the weakest phrasing of the three arms.
